name: A00_8_minus_eight_lets_you_cast_spells_from_hand_for_free_this_turn
notes: Printed: '[-8]: ... Until end of turn, you may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs.' Chandra at 9 loyalty, no land, an empty pool. The -8 draws Gnarled Sage ({3}{G}{G}), Shock ({R}) and Walking Corpse ({1}{B}) among its seven; each is cast from the hand through the permission (cast:<card>:via:<Chandra>, CR 118.9): MORE THAN ONE spell, a creature and an instant, nothing paid. Shock hits the opponent (20 -> 18). The opponent's own Shock, in its hand with no mana, is not made free by Chandra's -8 (illegal cast). Loyalty 9 -> 1.
